entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edith Dorothy Holman was a British tennis player and three time ILTF world champion twice in singles winning the World Covered Court Championships in 1919, and the World Hard Court Championships in 1920 and once in doubles the same year. In addition, she was a double silver medalist at the 1920 Summer Olympics.
